ay.den0707: Arno "Smokes" Den took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

Arno "Smokes" Den fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Arno "Rabbit" Calin, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything. The Hegemony took Hill 304. Arno "Smokes" Den watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Arno "Smokes" Den wrote to five brothers, all on other fronts. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.
Arno "Smokes" Den found a flower growing out of a sandbag. He did not tell anyone. He checks on it every morning.
A loose thread in Arno "Smokes" Den's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.

Arno "Smokes" Den smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil came out for a cup and was grazed. A letter from home reached Arno "Smokes" Den before dusk. Arno "Smokes" Den read it twice and slept a little easier. Arno "Smokes" Den's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

A round went through the rim of Arno "Smokes" Den's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Oskar Perry of the Hegemony (@bo.perry._). Blackwater Canal is lost. Arno "Smokes" Den heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Arno "Smokes" Den is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
brysen_miller1212: Edmund "Hollow" Miller introduced himself as a blacksmith from Wyvern Cross. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
Edmund "Hollow" Miller walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Edmund "Hollow" Miller owes Oskar Londonz so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.
david_jw_: Ulrich David introduced himself as a butcher's boy from Oakmere. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Ulrich David stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Ulrich David put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
grizzlychicken1: Arno "Hollow" Grizzlychick unpacked a dented harmonica at S-C16. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-C16, Arno "Hollow" Grizzlychick listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Arno "Hollow" Grizzlychick has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib, badly wounded.
gt3_di3go: After 9 days of war, T-S8 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Valentin Gtdigo.

Valentin Gtdigo came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir. A splinter opened Valentin Gtdigo's cheek at T-S8. A medic stitched it on the spot and he was back on the fire step before the tea went cold. Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Valentin Gtdigo wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Valentin Gtdigo walked back up the communication trench to T-S8, slower than before, but on his own feet.
ikanbili_s: Albin Ikanbili signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at Q-S10 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.

Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Albin Ikanbili stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Ikanbili. Albin Ikanbili read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A muddy dog crawled into Q-S10 through the wire. Albin Ikanbili gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Biscuit. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Ikanbili. Albin Ikanbili read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
james_servantofgod: Karel Servantofgod came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Karel Servantofgod kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Karel Servantofgod bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage. A letter from home reached Karel Servantofgod before dusk. Karel Servantofgod read it twice and slept a little easier.
king_baldwin_irl: Zeno Irl walked into R-F21 on Day 4 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Zeno Irl and Matthias Universal divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.

The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Zeno Irl ate two helpings anyway. The Hegemony secured Hill 304. Zeno Irl helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Dawn watch. Zeno Irl put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Quentin "Mud" Sperring, grazed.
Zeno Irl borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.
Zeno Irl fired at a movement across the wire at R-F21. The man went down: Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia, gravely wounded.
Zeno Irl fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Gustav Scottjseale, gravely wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-F21 changed before the cheering ended. Zeno Irl shouldered another load.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Zeno Irl was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
limaecho63: Marek Limaecho told the sergeant he was a lamplighter. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
On sentry duty Marek Limaecho watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.
mark_lacy: Gideon "Rabbit" Lacy reported to U-F5 with a photograph gone soft at the edges sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Gideon "Rabbit" Lacy lent Leopold Daddy a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.
rhylerbetz: Benedikt Rhylerbetz came up on Day 7 carrying news from Marrow Fen. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Benedikt Rhylerbetz saw a hare run the whole length of no man's land and nobody on either side fired at it.
Benedikt Rhylerbetz turned a year older today. The whole squad sang for him, badly, and the cook found a candle.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-S6, Benedikt Rhylerbetz listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Benedikt Rhylerbetz and Henrik Rossfm carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
